explanation: The theorem restates the defining property of the library's own `GradedLocalization.component`, the degree-i piece of `Localization M`. Its proof `⟨j, a, b, hb, rfl⟩` builds the witness directly. Mathlib's `HomogeneousLocalization` covers only the degree-0 part, as a separate type. Mathlib does not define a ι-grading on an ordinary localization, so no Mathlib statement matches. All of the content lies in the library's definition.
